reason: In src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:53,105, flusher processes are created via multiprocessing.get_context("spawn").Process (SpawnProcess), which inherits from multiprocessing.process.BaseProcess rather than multiprocessing.Process. Consequently, the isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) check guarding process.terminate() in join() at src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:346-347 (the same check used at lines 254-255) is always False, so flusher processes are never terminated on shutdown or rebalance.
